title: Jesus... Everyone From My Batch Is Doing Better Than Me
topic: comparing her career to her batchmates' online updates

bible.text: Each one should test his own work. Then he will have reason to boast in himself alone, and not in someone else. For each one should carry his own load.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I liked every batchmate's promotion post today. Then I sat in the bathroom feeling sick. 😔

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Abroad, promoted, engaged. I'm still here.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You're comparing your whole life to their best photo.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Maybe. But I never put you in their race.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Close their story. Open your own day. I'm walking it with you.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to the friend who thinks she's behind. 🤍
